g.text: Figure 7C User Requirement Diagram — Statutory Obligations
(SysML requirement notation expressed in PlantUML; source: spec 3.0-3.2, 12.4)
text = "Enable a single RCA to complete
As the RCA, I need the system to check the
client's ASIC registration and ABN before I
accept the engagement, and to stop at every
statutory decision point until I confirm it. It
should time the statutory notification deadlines
and stop me from signing while a notification is
pending or any other pre-signature condition is
unmet. I must be able to withdraw at any phase,
with the workpapers sealed when I do. Later, I
would like to reuse the client profile in the
Raised from O-02 to mandatory because
P0 depends on it (3.1): change history,
Acceptance: dueAt computed from awareDate and
not editable; escalated 3 days before due and
again when overdue; blocks RPT-01 while pending.
Box «requirement» = one requirement, carrying its id and text.
Crosshair line (+--) = SysML containment; the crosshair sits on the container.
Dashed arrow «deriveReqt» = the derived requirement points at its source.
Notes give the acceptance criteria from the traceability matrix (12.4).
Other requirements: Figure 7A (Member A), Figure 7B (Member B); full set in Figure 7.
